criteria.statement: Bahia maintenance commands publish only a conformant NIP-59 kind-1059 outer event and preserve correlation on the canonical rumor.
An absolute candidate path is absent from the serialized Bahia-to-worker wire event and recoverable only by the intended recipient.
Cascadia mirrors NIP-59 and legacy wrapped requests without plaintext response fallback, and required mode rejects plaintext before driver dispatch.
Maintenance ACL and Tier-2 signed approval tests remain green with the transport change.
